goal: Freshly geocode all Prince George restaurant records and Northern Health water-related facility records with Google Geocoding API, deduplicate requests to avoid repeated API calls, cache every Google response, and write latitude/longitude plus Google metadata back into the source JSON files.
why: Restaurant data already has some coordinates from an older Nominatim/OpenStreetMap run, but the request is to rerun fresh through Google.
Water datasets have no latitude/longitude fields yet.
Water datasets overlap heavily by facility name/city, so one Google result should be reused across drinking, bacteriological, chemical, and notice records where possible.

script.status: created but not committed at time of handoff
script.resume_behavior: The script stores each Google response in a cache file after every request. Re-running skips cached queries unless --force is used.
script.safety_behavior: The script defaults to dry-run. It only calls Google and writes data when --apply is provided. It aborts after repeated REQUEST_DENIED responses.

api_key.current_blocker: The existing key returns REQUEST_DENIED because the Google Geocoding API is not activated on the Google Cloud project.
api_key.google_console_hint: Enable Google Geocoding API for the key/project and confirm billing/key restrictions allow server-side Geocoding API requests.

restaurants.query_strategy: Use full_address or address, plus city/BC/Canada when needed. Fall back to name + city + BC, Canada.

notices.query_strategy: Use facility_location when present. Fall back to facility/name + location_summary/city + BC, Canada.

drinking.query_strategy: Use facility_location when present. Fall back to facility/name + city + BC, Canada.

bacteriological.query_strategy: Prefer an address result already found for the same facility-name/city key from drinking/notices. Fall back to name + city + BC, Canada.

chemical.query_strategy: Prefer an address result already found for the same facility-name/city key from drinking/notices. Fall back to name + city + BC, Canada.

cache.description: Reusable cache keyed by normalized query string. Stores raw interpreted Google response metadata for each unique query.

latest_attempt.result: Stopped early after Google returned REQUEST_DENIED.
latest_attempt.exact_google_error: This API is not activated on your API project. You may need to enable this API in the Google Cloud Console.

recommended_next_steps: Enable Google Geocoding API on the Google Cloud project for the key in /Users/ahmadjalil/github/PGfoodmap/.env.
Confirm billing and API key restrictions allow Geocoding API requests from this machine/script.
Inspect data/geocoding/google_geocode_cache.json for OK, ZERO_RESULTS, REQUEST_DENIED, or OVER_QUERY_LIMIT statuses.
If the test looks good, run the full command: ./venv_healthspace/bin/python geocode_google_all.py --apply.
After completion, commit geocode_google_all.py, data/geocoding/google_geocoding_handoff.json, data/geocoding/google_geocode_cache.json, and the updated restaurant/water JSON files.
notes: This handoff intentionally does not contain the API key.
Google Geocoding API calls may cost money. The expected fresh workload is 1313 unique requests.
Water coordinate attachment is facility-level, not sample-tap-level. Sample locations such as room sinks are not geocoded separately.
Some Google results may be partial matches or approximate location types; downstream UI should treat google_partial_match and google_location_type as confidence hints.
